title: Environment Verification Snapshot
description: Rule 6 (Environment First) preamble artifact produced by 00_environment.sh. Documents the execution environment that every downstream metric extraction is computed against. Loaded by 09_compute_metrics.py and 10_render_report.py at read boundaries.

repository_url.description: Git remote URL with embedded auth credentials stripped (the producer applies a redact_url helper before writing). Example: https://github.com/Blitzy-Sandbox/blitzy-RudderStack.

total_commit_count.description: Total commits reachable from HEAD as reported by `git rev-list --count HEAD`.

active_branch_count.description: Count of refs matching refs/heads/ and refs/remotes/origin/ at extraction time.

submodule_state.description: Derived from `git submodule status`: 'clean' if all submodules at expected SHAs, 'no_submodules' if .gitmodules absent or empty, 'dirty' if any submodule diverges.

earliest.description: Earliest commit author date in ISO-8601 UTC (e.g., 2026-02-23T05:19:38Z).

latest.description: Latest commit author date in ISO-8601 UTC.

extraction_timestamp.description: Wall-clock timestamp at which the environment snapshot was captured, ISO-8601 UTC.

run_id.description: Per-run correlation ID (UUID4) generated by 00_environment.sh and propagated via BLITZY_RUN_ID.
